candidateIdentity.variantName: Black dial on black Silicone Ocean strap with khaki quick-release nylon accessory strap

sourceChecks.note: Vaer's exact live product route publishes the black 36 mm S3 Calendar Field with the selected black Silicone Ocean and khaki nylon strap bundle. Its technical panel independently supplies 316L steel, 36 x 8.4 x 43 mm geometry, 20 mm lug width, GM12 quartz, -10/+20 seconds per month, 100 m resistance, screw-down crown, sapphire, a date window, quick-release straps, and an exact-reference 6/10 lume-performance rating. It identifies 46 g specifically as case weight, not full worn weight.

Vaer's public Shopify product payload resolves exact variant 41255028424838, SKU S3-CF-SIL20BLK-NY20KHA, USD 189 pricing, available-for-sale state, and the selected Silicone Ocean Black plus Nylon Khaki options. Its raw weight value 369 has no published unit or wearable-versus-shipping scope and is not accepted as watch mass.

Vaer's exact black Silicone Ocean strap route identifies a waterproof, quick-release 20 mm strap. Its public product payload reports an unexplained weight value of 88 shared by every color and is not treated as a measured strap mass.

Vaer's exact khaki nylon accessory route identifies dense waterproof nylon, 20 mm width, and quick-release spring bars. The accessory is included in the purchased SKU but is not the selected worn configuration used for a future full-weight fact.

Perplexity surfaced an exact-model subjective report describing the lume as serviceable rather than impressive while remaining readable overnight. Direct retrieval returned HTTP 403, and the report provides no controlled charge or measured brightness protocol; the accepted moderate mapping instead comes from Vaer's exact 6/10 performance rating.

A narrow Perplexity follow-up surfaced a 35 g without-strap claim for an S3 field watch, but exact Calendar Field SKU identity and a weighing protocol are not established. It also conflicts with Vaer's exact page calling 46 g the case weight. Neither head-only value can satisfy the full configured weight contract.

The exact SKU is present, but the aggregator record describes an orange-dial/beige-strap variant and an implausible 54.2 bar rating rather than the reviewed black bundle. It supplies no full-watch mass or weighing protocol, so it cannot resolve weightFullG. Retrieved 2026-08-31.
